basis: Inline C# fragments (the included ranges of the SVC composite and the CodeBehind reference case) are derived from the C# grammar rules (grammar.json) by a hand-written parser of the exact C# subset the valid fragments use (using, namespace, class, interface, attribute list with named arguments, method, field, parameter, return, string literal with escapes, member access, binary +, line comments); the root spans from its first child to the end of the included range. The two fact queries are interpreted from their source text by a small matcher (node patterns, wildcards, fields, the first-child anchor, captures) over the derived tree and kept as an unordered multiset with the pattern index. Dynamic SQL facts follow the fact pack rule: a CSHARP_COMMAND fact needs a capture of the oc.arg, ini.as or ma.as pattern, so none means zero facts. Fragments with a preprocessor directive (external scanner) and fragments outside the language (error recovery) are BLOCKED and never guessed.
